verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate card and spend-management platform with an API. Automation rules, such as auto-categorization, are a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the versioning and rollback axis applies. The evidence pack shows no versioning, change review, or rollback of automations. Payment approvals and editable categories are adjacent features, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
